component.name: Familiar
component.summary: Play MUDs, MUSHes, MUCKs and MOOs

description.p: Familiar is a client for text-based multiplayer worlds: MUDs, MUSHes, MUCKs and MOOs. It is inspired by BeipMU and can import BeipMU's settings, maps and scripts.

ul.li: Tabs for each world, colour and Unicode output, clickable links and logging
Triggers, aliases, keyboard macros, variables and JavaScript scripting
A map that draws itself from GMCP Room.Info, and walks you to any room
GMCP stat bars, server sounds, web views and inline images
MCP 2.1 with a program editor that highlights and indents MOO and MUF code
Puppets in their own tabs, text to speech and spell checking
A terminal version with the same features, for SSH and tiling setups
